`enum BlendState.Factor`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.state` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [BlendState.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/state/BlendState.java)

A weight that a blend state applies to the source or the destination color before its equation.

## Description

The source is the color being drawn, the destination the color already on the target; every weight is on 1.

## Learn more

- [Drawing resources and transforms](/use/learn/going-further/drawing-resources-and-transforms/#blend-with-what-is-under)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`ZERO`](#BlendState-Factor-value-ZERO) | Weight `0`: drops that side. |
| [`ONE`](#BlendState-Factor-value-ONE) | Weight `1`: keeps that side as it is. |
| [`SRC_COLOR`](#BlendState-Factor-value-SRC_COLOR) | Multiplies by the color being drawn, channel by channel. |
| [`ONE_MINUS_SRC_COLOR`](#BlendState-Factor-value-ONE_MINUS_SRC_COLOR) | Multiplies by `1` minus the color being drawn, channel by channel. |
| [`DST_COLOR`](#BlendState-Factor-value-DST_COLOR) | Multiplies by the color on the target, channel by channel: with `ZERO` as destination factor, the two colors multiply. |
| [`ONE_MINUS_DST_COLOR`](#BlendState-Factor-value-ONE_MINUS_DST_COLOR) | Multiplies by `1` minus the color on the target, channel by channel. |
| [`SRC_ALPHA`](#BlendState-Factor-value-SRC_ALPHA) | Multiplies by the alpha of the color being drawn. |
| [`ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA`](#BlendState-Factor-value-ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA) | Multiplies by `1` minus the alpha of the color being drawn. |
| [`DST_ALPHA`](#BlendState-Factor-value-DST_ALPHA) | Multiplies by the alpha on the target. |
| [`ONE_MINUS_DST_ALPHA`](#BlendState-Factor-value-ONE_MINUS_DST_ALPHA) | Multiplies by `1` minus the alpha on the target. |
